title: 深紫外光阻塗佈
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解塗佈流動、邊珠、膜厚與缺陷，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore coating flow, edge bead, thickness and defects through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 光阻與基板

stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for resist and substrate, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 曝光波長匹配

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Match exposure wavelength. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: DUV resist selection needs wavelength-specific data, not appearance. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.check: 交付「曝光波長匹配」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for match exposure wavelength: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.
